sections.COMMENTS: This seismogenic source was first proposed by Malaroda and Raimondi (1957) based on geological and seismological evidence. This seismogenic source was also suggested by Materazzi et al. (2022) based on geological evidence, and reassessment of the macroseismic field of the 24 April 1741, Mw 6.2, Fabrianese earthquake.
